```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Configure rendering and load the report packages.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(knitr)
}))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the completed results and shared report controls.
source("report-setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())
```

The dictionary records the role, size, sensitivity, and checksum of every included
pipeline result. It also defines table columns and quantitative figures.

```{r}
# Provide the three complete report dictionaries.
buttonROW(
  downloadBUTTON("provenance/output_files.tsv", "Download result-file dictionary"),
  downloadBUTTON("provenance/data_dictionary.tsv", "Download column dictionary"),
  downloadBUTTON("provenance/figure_manifest.tsv", "Download figure dictionary")
)
```

## Result files

```{r}
# Display every included pipeline file with its sensitivity and download.
fileVIEW <- copy(manifest)
fileVIEW[, download := sprintf(
  '<a class="dnaprs-download" href="%s" download>Download</a>',
  relative_path
)]
tableVIEW(
  fileVIEW[, .(
    section = publish_path,
    file = file_name,
    description,
    size_bytes = bytes,
    sensitivity,
    sha256,
    download
  )],
  "All pipeline files included in this report bundle.",
  escape = FALSE
)
```

## Table columns

```{r}
# Display definitions for columns supplied by tabular pipeline results.
dataDICTIONARY <- fread(file.path("provenance", "data_dictionary.tsv"))
tableVIEW(dataDICTIONARY, "Column definitions for tabular pipeline outputs.")
```

## Figures

```{r}
# Display the quantitative figure dictionary and available file formats.
tableVIEW(
  figureMANIFEST[, .(
    figure_id,
    page,
    section,
    title,
    description,
    inspection,
    width_in,
    height_in,
    dpi,
    tiff,
    png,
    jpeg
  )],
  "Figures generated from completed pipeline results."
)
```
